messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV2 - metering: unusual token emission spike detected (pd-8731). token_count_delta = +18% vs rolling 24h. alerting oncall @sara. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/metrics/emit_delta

sara: saw it, acking now. jumping in to triage. first pass: emitter service showing increased batch latency + late commits.

liam: what's the customer impact? any overage flags firing?

sara: yes — billing flags triggered for a handful of tenants (~12) between 02:12-02:30 UTC. looks like late batches from the usage-aggregator got reprocessed and double-counted tokens on emit replay.

julia: (from logs) piping a quick query ->
```
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) as tokens, event_time FROM usage_emit WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-17T02:00:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
```
results show spikes for tenant_42 and tenant_9.

billing-ops: confirmed. we've seen auto-overage emails go out for tenant_9 and tenant_17. opening support tickets to pause billing notifications.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) pause usage-emitter (toggle emit.enabled=false) 2) disable retry/replay worker 3) run dedupe job against last 6h window 4) temporarily suppress overage alerts for affected tenants. executing step 1 now.

alex: step 1 done — emitter toggled off (emit.enabled=false) on prod-west-1. logs show emitter halted.

liam: can you share the command you used so I can replicate if needed?

sara: sure:
```
# pause emitter
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/usage-emitter EMIT_ENABLED=false --record
```

julia: starting dedupe dry-run. rough estimate: ~40k duplicate token events across tenants. will post exact SQL soon.

billing-ops: suppressing overage alerts for tenant_9 and tenant_17 now, added note to support tickets. we'll re-enable after dedupe completes and counts reconcile.

eng-sre: quick note — this looks like a race in the commit window where delayed kafka partitions were reprocessed after transient outage. recommending we add idempotency keys at emitter join step. filing an infra follow-up (INFRA-529).

liam: handoff checklist for night oncall (assigned to me at 03:15 UTC): - ensure emitter remains off - monitor dedupe job progress and errors - confirm reconciled counts before re-enabling alerts - coordinate with billing to clear customer emails or send corrected notices - escalate to oncall-sre if dedupe >2h

sara: handing off. current state: emitter paused, dedupe job running (10% complete), billing suppression active, PD incident pd-8731 updated with mitigation steps. last known impact window 02:12-02:30 UTC. handing to @liam for overnight monitoring.

liam: ack. I'll take it. posting monitoring queries and alert tweaks in #eng-sre. please DM if any urgent customer replies land.

julia: one more data point — approx 0.6% of total daily tokens affected, but concentrated on high-traffic tenants which triggered overage thresholds. we'll need a communication plan with support once counts are stable.

billing-ops: drafting outbound message to impacted customers explaining false positives and that we will reverse erroneous overage charges. will wait for final reconciliation before sending.

incident-bot: Incident pd-8731 status: mitigation in progress -> assigned to liam for monitoring. next update requested in 30m.

liam: noted. will post progress updates every 30m in this thread until resolved.

sara: thanks team, appreciate the quick responses.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from alex, :eyes: from julia)
